description: Election Commission - D. P. G. I. Gunasena was selected as the member of the Kadugannawa Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Kadugannawa Urban Council) due to the death of an elected member. The process is conducted under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, involving the nomination of a new member by a political party and the formal declaration by the Returning Officer. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the composition of an elected local authority body, fitting the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
